summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. priced $800,000 of Senior Capped Leveraged Dual Directional Notes due September 29, 2028, linked to Class A common stock of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (Nasdaq: SPCX). Notes price at $1,000 each with a 200.00% participation rate, a maximum payment of $1,650.00 per note (165.00% of stated principal), a $149.24 initial value and a $89.54 threshold (60%). Issued under a Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, unsecured and unsubordinated; payments subject to Jefferies credit risk, with investors exposed to underlying declines below threshold. This is an ordinary structured-note takedown, not a special situation.
